stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Builder and Recruiting Filter Enforcement
stories.description: Implement query construction logic to call ClinicalTrials.gov API with correct parameters, ensuring recruiting status filter is always enforced and condition/location inputs are properly encoded.

stories.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Extract trial site locations from ClinicalTrials.gov response and normalize into structured format (city, state, coordinates if available) for downstream distance computation.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes API
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site, including handling missing or invalid route responses.

stories.title: External API Error Handling and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Implement robust error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API failures, including timeouts, partial responses, and graceful degradation (return trials without distance when necessary).

stories.title: Clinical Trials Response Formatting for Chat Consumption
stories.description: Format aggregated trial data (metadata, recruiting status, locations, distance, duration) into a clean, structured response suitable for LLM consumption and frontend rendering.
